title: Surreal Desert Siren
description: A surreal scene depicts a red-skinned woman with a flower crown and bone necklace emerging from the desert sand, her lower body transforming into a skeletal horse with a flowing purple mane. A winding river of blood cuts through the sandy landscape toward a distant castle, surrounded by oversized flies, dragonflies, pink flowers, and agave plants under a pale blue sky.
